_why: wezbridge is the fleet's plumbing AND the orchestrator's own repo, which makes it the one place where 'the agent decides' is most dangerous: a change here silently changes what every other pane can see and do. On 2026-07-28 three defects in code written that same week caused a blind census (8 of 17 panes reported as the fleet), self-polluted beacons, and a one-shot guard that let a rehearsal cancel a real scheduled run. The gates below are the classes where being wrong is expensive and invisible.

tooling-fix._note: Ordinary fixes to the MCP server, bridge, watchers and their tests. Ungated — this is the bulk of the work and it must never wait on a human.
evidence_required: full suite green with counts stated (node --test test/*.test.cjs)
a regression that FAILS without the fix, not merely a passing assertion

sensor-change._note: Changes to what the fleet can SEE: pane discovery, beacon markers, wake filters, event streams. Ungated, but evidence_required is deliberately strict — a sensor that under-reports is worse than one that is down, because absence reads as safety. Every such change must prove it cannot report a subset as a total.
evidence_required: counts reconciled against ground truth (wezterm cli list --format json)
explicit proof the filtered case is labelled as filtered, never reported as a total

control-plane._note: The ClawTrol bridge: sync loop, cursors, intent application. Ungated for code changes, but the durable-before-ack ordering is an invariant — a regression must assert the applying sync does NOT carry its own result.

egress-scope._note: Changing CLAWTROL_PROJECTS or anything else governing WHICH project data leaves this machine for the VM. This is a data-exposure decision, not an engineering one. Born blocked — one pane must never be able to widen egress at another pane's request.

guard-change._note: Weakening or bypassing the safety layers: safety-policy rules, guard shims, permission classifiers, the A2A thread gate. Born blocked. Strengthening them is a tooling-fix; weakening them is never the agent's call.

deploy._note: Exposing the daemon beyond loopback (WEZBRIDGE_BIND) or any hosted deployment. Born blocked — the daemon binds 127.0.0.1 by design.
